title: Kicked Salty Saudi Arabian Lentil Stew
description: A salty, tender, and comforting Saudi Arabian dish featuring tamarind pulp, perfect for a sick day, this plant-based-friendly stew is made with red lentils and a blend of aromatic spices, pressure-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper and stir for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, tamarind pulp, and vegetable broth, and stir to combine.
Close the lid and set the valve to sealing, then pressure-cook for 20 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Open the lid and check that the lentils are tender, then serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or crusty bread, if desired.
